title: Simple Clip
description: A plugin that allows you to smoothly noclip through blocks in creative mode with the help of a client side mod. Similar to Axiom no clip.
body:
# 🧱 Simple Clip Plugin

A lightweight and powerful plugin for **Paper**, **Spigot**, and **Bukkit** servers that unlocks advanced building and movement capabilities.

---

## ⚠️ Important

> This plugin **does nothing on its own**.

It is not a standalone feature plugin and **requires [the client mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-clip-fabric)** to function. Without the mod installed on a compatible mod loader, this plugin will have no effect.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🚪 `/noclip`

* Move freely through blocks with ease
* Perfect for building, inspecting, or navigating tight spaces
* Designed to work seamlessly with a **client-side Fabric mod**
* Inspired by functionality similar to the Axiom plugin

### 🧩 `/forceplace`

* Place blocks without restrictions
* Bypass placement limitations for greater creative control
* Ideal for advanced builders and server staff

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

* A **Fabric client-side mod** is required for `/noclip` and `/forceplace` commands to function properly
* Compatible with:

  * Paper
  * Spigot
  * Bukkit

---

## 🔐 Permissions

* By default, **server operators (OPs)** have access to all commands
* Additional permission configuration can be added as needed

---

## 📌 Use Cases

* Build and edit structures without obstruction
* Debug or inspect builds behind walls or underground
* Enhance creative workflows with fewer limitations

---

## 🚀 Summary

This plugin is a simple yet powerful addition to any server, giving players and staff the ability to move and build without constraints—while remaining lightweight and easy to use.
